summary: A Yes vote authorizes the La Mesa-Spring Valley School District to extend its existing bond tax rate to issue $131,000,000 in general obligation bonds to repair and upgrade school facilities.

tax.text: The Yes campaign supports extending the current property-tax rate to fund local school repairs and upgrades.
tax.quote: Measure AA is a bond extension measure which will fund local school repairs and upgrades by extending, but not increasing, the current $22 per $100,000 of assessed value tax rate.

schools.text: The Yes campaign says Measure AA funds would be reserved exclusively for La Mesa-Spring Valley School District schools.
schools.quote: No funds can be taken by the County, State or Federal government, or used for other purposes. All funds from the potential bond measure will benefit LMSVSD schools only.

tax.text: A No vote would reject $131 million in bonds funded by an annual property-tax levy of $22 per $100,000 of assessed value.
tax.quote: The measure would levy $22 per $100,000 of assessed value ($9,000,000 annually) while the bonds are outstanding.
